tittel: Alibi – a speakeasy in the cellar, Alta
beskrivelse: Alibi is a speakeasy in a cellar at Sentrumsparken 2, Alta. Cocktails, dimmed lights and darkened wood. Knock – what you see here stays between us.
og_beskrivelse: A cellar in Alta. A door without a sign – almost. Knock.
og_bilde_alt: The Alibi logo in brass on a dark background, with the Norwegian line «Speakeasy i kjelleren · Alta»
jsonld_beskrivelse: Speakeasy bar in the cellar beneath the restaurant Raus in Alta town centre, inspired by Prohibition-era America.
dor_aria: Knock on the door. Three knocks will let you in.
hero_linje: You found us. What you see here stays between us.
historien_1: In the twenties, in the country across the sea, they closed the bars and thought people would stop meeting. People did not stop meeting. They simply went down one flight of stairs, knocked three times and gave a name that was not their own. Down there, behind doors without signs, they sat closer, spoke lower and drank better than ever before.
historien_2: Alibi is our flight of stairs. A bar in a cellar in Alta town centre, furnished for those who would rather have a good conversation than a good picture of it. The pace here is slow and the music slower: dimmed lights, wood that has been allowed to darken, and cocktails made as though someone might still knock on the door and ask what we are up to.
historien_3: We are not going to shout about this place. We don't need to. The right people always find their way.

alt_ford: A 1920s vintage car seen from the front
huset_motto: Eat upstairs. Nightclub next door. Talk here.
huset_ingress: One house, three places: Raus at street level, Tåkt and Alibi side by side in the cellar below. Our neighbours are a step away – the rest of the evening takes care of itself.
raus_foto_aria: Placeholder for a photo of Raus
raus_tekst: Arctic tapas at street level. It's the house you see from the street.

taakt_tekst: Nightclub in the cellar, right next door to us. They take care of the dancing.
alt_lampe: Fringed table lamp lighting a corner with a brick wall and a leather sofa
alibi_tekst: Bar in the same cellar. Slow pace, slower music, good conversation.
menyen_ingress: Our own handwriting. Some of these we made up ourselves.
fotnote_alkoholfritt: There is an alcohol-free version of everything. Ask whoever is behind the bar.
fotnote_allergi: Some of our drinks contain raw egg white. Tell us about any allergies and we will find you something else.
fotnote_urter: We grow the mint, basil and rosemary ourselves.

finn_oss_1: Look for the restaurant Raus{{ny_fane}} – you can see it from the street. Beneath it lies the cellar: if you can hear the bass, you are standing at Tåkt{{ny_fane}}. Our door is the quiet one.
finn_oss_2: You will find us in the same building as Canyon Hotell{{ny_fane}}.
